issue_context.title: RLS policy empty state is confusing
issue_context.body: # Bug report ## Describe the bug Empty state for RLS policies does not indicate that you need tables in public schema ## To Reproduce Steps to reproduce the behavior, please provide code snippets or a repository: 1. Create new project 2. Go to auth > policies ## Expected behavior A clear and concise CTA to create a table in public schema, rather than the generic "Hmm, we couldn't find any results that matches your query. Try another?" ## Screenshots If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem. ## System information - OS: [e.g. macOS, Windows] - Browser (if applies) [e.g. chrome, safari] - Version of supabase-js: [e.g. 6.0.2] - Version of Node.js: [e.g. 10.10.0] ## Additional context Add any other context about the problem here.
comments: Hi @MildTomato , can I be assigned to this? I would like to help work on this

Hey @louis-27 I assigned you to this issue, and if you need any help just let me know. The file is located here [`studio/components/to-be-cleaned/NoSearchResults.tsx`](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/blob/master/studio/components/to-be-cleaned/NoSearchResults.tsx).

Hi @Isaiah-Hamilton , I added another conditional to render a cta for users with no public tables yet. I didn't change the NoSearchResults component as it would be used for table filtering. 

Take a look at this video and let me know if I should style or rephrase the cta another way



https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/48682663/157069535-1e5c148a-13f8-430a-9f21-58b960269d0a.mov

@louis-27 looking great!

1. Would it be ok to link to /editor instead of /database from that empty state CTA?
Although possibly we could just link to both pages with different links.

2. Maybe a better phrase in the box could be

```
No public tables found

A public schema table is required before you can create a row-level security policy
```

Feel free to pull request and we can get this merged in pretty quick.
@MildTomato just made the PR! Forgot to request a reviewer 😅

review_comments: quick question - any reason why we shouldn't use ProductEmptyState directly, and instead create a NoTableState as a wrapper around that? just feels unnecessary

hi, sorry for the late reply. Previously, the CreateTrigger component was doing NoTableState, and from this issue, the  auth/policies.tsx page needed to do the same (same set of props, but with a different message inside). So I decided to make a separate component for NoTableState to be used by CreateTrigger and the auth/policies.tsx page
